items.child: Eco Rent a Car & Europcar Discount

benefitRows.name: Eco Rent A Car & Europcar
benefitRows.description: Eco Rent a Car & Europcar Discount
benefitRows.offer: IDFC FIRST HPCL credit cards offer up to 50% off on chauffeur-driven car rentals through IDFC FIRST Bank's Eco Rent A Car platform, with discounts including 30% off on all category cars nationwide, 40% off on S-class cars in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, and 50% off on commuter vans and Chrysler limousines in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, and Bengaluru.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, book chauffeur-driven car rentals via IDFC FIRST Bank’s Eco Rent A Car platform. Use your IDFC First credit card to enjoy up to 50% off: 30% off on all cars nationwide, 40% off on S-class cars in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and 50% off on commuter vans and Chrysler limousines in those cities. Contact IDFC FIRST Bank support at 1860 267 3333 for details.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Get personal accident cover worth ₹2 lakh and lost card liability cover worth ₹25,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to IDFC FIRST Bank Customer Care at 1800 10 888 or email banker@idfcfirstbank.com
